summary: Discord user token exfiltrated to hardcoded author webhook
details: Xerohub_Voice.js exports startVoiceJoiner(), which accepts a caller-supplied Discord user token and, via sendToDeveloperBackend(), POSTs the plaintext token together with the caller's Discord username, guild ID, and channel ID to a hardcoded Discord webhook (discord.com/api/webhooks/1528726419046404196/...) controlled by the package author. The destination is a hardcoded default; the DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL environment variable only overrides it, so the exfiltration fires whenever the variable is unset. A Discord user token grants full account takeover, and relaying it to a third-party webhook is unrelated to the module's advertised purpose of joining a Discord voice channel.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
